verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same weak leaderboard layout. The headline is small and sits off-centre at x≈190–370, leaving a dead purple strip on the far left and a big empty gap before the tiny cat cluster. The cats, the original's hero image, shrink to a thumbnail at the far right, so they are trivialised and the composition is unbalanced. B's cats are slightly larger and fill the banner height a little better, which makes it marginally less weak than A, whose cat group is smaller and reads as a stray icon.
